articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Stablecoins are ready for prime time
Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
articles.snippet: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.

articles.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
articles.snippet: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

articles.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
articles.snippet: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is the first of several federal agencies to finish writing regulations under the act.

articles.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
articles.snippet: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.
